tree/tertullian-s-voice.quote: Jerome, who wrote his life, says the envy and insults of the clergy of Rome drove him to the New Prophecy.
tree/tertullian-s-voice.asks: Envy of what, insults over what?

tree/tertullian-s-voice.quote: Later he broke from the prophets too and gathered meetings of his own.
tree/tertullian-s-voice.asks: Why did he break from them?
